integrity: Proof and 113 computational checks in the package; finite checks are corroborative only. Closest accessible full papers were compared on the claimed sampling geometry.
scientific_limitations: The angular-product condition is sufficient for phaseless polynomial recovery in all degrees and necessary only in degree two. Determinant maximization is relative to the specified real Fourier coefficient coordinates; no global noise-stability conclusion is claimed.
title: Balanced two-circle phase retrieval: an angular-product determinant and all optimal grids
